study_note: Single-cell Oscar exact-resume manifest for the 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk analytic behavior-KL dual-schedule run at seed 56. It retains the five-head min_all reward-only MC-value base and evaluates paper-deterministic and stochastic-Bellman Q-versus-MC metrics at step zero and every 50,000 decisions with 100 samples. Portable best/latest checkpoints are evaluated every 100,000 decisions; hourly exact-resume generations are managed separately by the Oscar launcher.
